name: Morgan L. Escott
label: Content Strategist & AI-Assisted Marketing Leader | B2B SaaS Campaign & Narrative Expert
summary:
Creative and strategic marketing leader with 10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS, EdTech, and agency environments, specializing in content strategy, campaign execution, and narrative development. I excel at transforming raw inputs into cohesive, activation-ready content across diverse channels, leveraging AI-assisted workflows for ideation, distillation, and repurposing. My expertise spans building scalable content systems, developing human-first messaging that performs, and driving cross-functional alignment between marketing and sales. I bring a journalist's precision to every word, a systems thinker's rigor to every process, and a collaborative mindset to every project.

After a fulfilling 8-year tenure at Treering Yearbooks, I took intentional time in 2024–25 to support a loved one's health and invest in professional growth. I'm excited to return with renewed focus on individual contributor roles where writing, strategic thinking, and campaign execution converge in mission-driven, remote environments.

experience.title: Sales/Marketing Strategy + QA Expert (AI Training)
description: QA'd AI-generated marketing campaign builds and performance outputs, aligning evaluation criteria with best practices in HubSpot and Salesforce execution.
Evaluated AI-generated sales and marketing content for accuracy and alignment with industry standards, annotating conversational data to improve content quality.

experience.title: Creative Strategy Lead & Senior Sales Development Manager
description: Founded and chaired a Content Committee to unify brand voice and content governance; built a scalable library of 129 Outreach sequences and 55 SDR personas, accelerating onboarding and ensuring consistent messaging.
Authored 100+ email campaigns across niche audience segments, translating raw inputs from market research and customer stories into cohesive, activation-ready content.
Set the voice benchmark for the entire SDR team — authored voice/tone guidelines adopted team-wide; rep-written sequences were QA'd against my standard.
Developed and delivered monthly live + async SDR training for 20+ employees on messaging, campaign strategy, QA, and Outreach.io best practices, fostering a collaborative learning environment.
Created Treering's SDR Process Map (escottmorgan.wixsite.com/processmap), an 8-step workflow website used as the primary new-hire training resource and referenced in the official SDR training deck.
Drove 74% open rate and 22% reply rate on PTA Council campaigns with zero opt-outs — Treering's hardest-to-reach audience segment, paired with Thnks gifting and Facebook group research.
Achieved 85% open rate and 39% reply rate on Hot Zone Spring 1st Touch sequence (89 contacts), demonstrating precision in campaign messaging.
Launched January 2022 sequence suite of 6 campaigns — 63% average open rate (every sequence above 50%), 8.7% reply rate, 4.3% click rate, 3,337 prospects added.
Introduced AI (ChatGPT/Grammarly) into the campaign workflow to scale personalization and accelerate content development, applying editorial judgment to refine outputs.
Led selection and full implementation of Outreach.io as the team's primary sequencing platform — managed CRM integration, data migration, and team-wide adoption training.
